files.html: //! shapes_showcase - a grid of animated 2D shape primitives. Exercises the new //! gradient / polygon / fan / outline primitives (drawCircleGradient, drawCircleLines, //! drawPoly, drawPolyLines, drawRectangleGradientVertical/Ex, drawTriangleFan, drawTriangleLines) //! alongside existing ones (sectors, ellipses, splines, dashed lines), on the shared //! scaffold. Adapted from raylib's shapes showcase; self-running. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const radFromDeg = zm.radFromDeg; const float = zm.float; const common = @import("example_common"); const Vec2 = zm.Vec2; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); const cols: usize = 4; const rows: usize = 3; const State = struct { font: z.Font, }; fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { s.* = .{ .font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 24) }; } /// Centre of grid cell `i` (row-major), below the top caption strip. fn cellCenter( i: usize, w: f32, h: f32, ) Vec2 { const cw: f32 = w / float(cols); const ch: f32 = (h - 30.0) / float(rows); const col: f32 = float(i % cols); const row: f32 = float(i / cols); return .{ col * cw + cw * 0.5, 30.0 + row * ch + ch * 0.5 }; } /// Small caption under a cell's shape. fn label( gl: anytype, font: z.Font, c: Vec2, txt: []const u8, r: f32, ) void { gl.text(.{ c[0] - r, c[1] + r + 4 }, txt, .{ .size = 11, .color = common.palette.ink_dim, .font = &font }); } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { const t: f32 = f.time.time; const w: f32 = f.window.widthf(); const h: f32 = f.window.heightf(); const r: f32 = @min(w / float(cols), (h - 30.0) / float(rows)) * 0.30; const ang: f32 = t * 40.0; z.clearViewport(f, common.palette.bg); common.backdrop(f.gl, w, h); { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(0, w, h); f.gl.circleGradient(.{ c[0], c[1] }, r, common.palette.accent, common.palette.surface); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "circleGradient", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(1, w, h); f.gl.circle(c, r, .{ .color = common.palette.accent2, .outline = 1 }); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "circleLines", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(2, w, h); f.gl.poly(c, 5, r, radFromDeg(ang), .{ .color = common.palette.good }); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "poly(5)", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(3, w, h); f.gl.polyLines(c, 6, r, radFromDeg(-ang), .{ .color = common.palette.warn }); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "polyLines(6)", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(4, w, h); f.gl.rectGradientVertical(c[0] - r, c[1] - r, 2.0 * r, 2.0 * r, common.palette.accent, common.palette.accent2); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "rectGradV", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(5, w, h); const rec: z.Rectangle = .{ .x = c[0] - r, .y = c[1] - r, .width = 2.0 * r, .height = 2.0 * r }; f.gl.rectGradientCorners( rec, common.palette.ramp(0), common.palette.ramp(90), common.palette.ramp(180), common.palette.ramp(270), ); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "rectGradEx", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(6, w, h); const pts = [_]Vec2{ c, .{ c[0] - r, c[1] + r * 0.5 }, .{ c[0] - r * 0.5, c[1] - r }, .{ c[0] + r * 0.5, c[1] - r }, .{ c[0] + r, c[1] + r * 0.5 }, }; f.gl.triangleFan(&pts, .{ .color = common.palette.accent.fade(0.8) }); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "triangleFan", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(7, w, h); f.gl.triangleLines( .{ c[0], c[1] - r }, .{ c[0] - r, c[1] + r }, .{ c[0] + r, c[1] + r }, .{ .color = common.palette.ink }, ); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "triangleLines", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(8, w, h); f.gl.circleSector(c, r, 0, radFromDeg(@mod(ang * 3.0, 360.0)), 32, .{ .color = common.palette.good.fade(0.7) }); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "circleSector", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(9, w, h); f.gl.ellipse(c, r * 1.2, r * 0.7, .{ .color = common.palette.accent2.fade(0.7) }); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "ellipse", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(10, w, h); const pts = [_]Vec2{ .{ c[0] - r, c[1] }, .{ c[0] - r * 0.5, c[1] - r * 0.6 }, .{ c[0], c[1] + r * 0.6 }, .{ c[0] + r * 0.5, c[1] - r * 0.6 }, .{ c[0] + r, c[1] }, }; f.gl.splineLinear(&pts, 3.0, .{ .color = common.palette.accent }); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "splineLinear", r); } { const c: Vec2 = cellCenter(11, w, h); f.gl.lineDashed(.{ c[0] - r, c[1] - r }, .{ c[0] + r, c[1] + r }, 3.0, 8.0, 6.0, .{ .color = common.palette.warn, }); label(f.gl, s.font, c, "lineDashed", r); } common.caption(f.gl, s.font, "shapes showcase: 2D primitives"); z.endDrawing(f.gl); } /// Descriptor-only: the runner (standalone) or a launcher drives this. pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - WebGPU - shapes showcase", .width = 800, .height = 450, .scale_mode = .responsive, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, };
